code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = 2
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != marker)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (marker, background)]
    if not coords:
        return out
    full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == marker for c in range(w))]
    full_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(h))]
    if full_rows:
        wall = full_rows[0]
        minr, maxr = min(r for r,c in coords), max(r for r,c in coords)
        dr = (wall + 1 - minr) if minr > wall else (wall - 1 - maxr)
        for r,c in coords:
            out[r][c] = background
        moved = [(r+dr,c,grid[r][c]) for r,c in coords]
        for r,c,v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        edge = max(r for r,c,v in moved) + 1 if dr >= 0 else min(r for r,c,v in moved) - 1
        if 0 <= edge < h:

    elif full_cols:
        wall = full_cols[0]
        minc, maxc = min(c for r,c in coords), max(c for r,c in coords)
        dc = (wall + 1 - minc) if minc > wall else (wall - 1 - maxc)
        for r,c in coords:
            out[r][c] = background
        moved = [(r,c+dc,grid[r][c]) for r,c in coords]
        for r,c,v in moved:
            out[r][c] = v
        edge = max(c for r,c,v in moved) + 1 if dc >= 0 else min(c for r,c,v in moved) - 1
        if 0 <= edge < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][edge] = 8
    return out
'''
